text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару doesn't show up for
training,
so I go and look for her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The omen to beware of lightning...
again?! But
why? It's so sunny outside...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: You're busy with divining, I see...

text_block_list.text:
Upon closer inspection... Th-those
clouds look
kind of menacing, right?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Aren't you forgetting something? Starts with a t, ends with a raining...

text_block_list.text:
I give her a storm of a scolding so this
doesn't
happen again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
